title: Create check in system
description:
The backend defines endpoints to use for `UserCheckIn` models.
They provide ways for creating, updating, deleting and listing checkins available for a given user. This app needs to remain dumb and rely on the backend for storing and control over the checkins.
The only thing this needs to do, is periodically check the backend (once every 1hr) for checkins for a given user and if the time is appropriate then send the correct message to the user.
All the information about the backend endpoints is both in the `swagger.json` as well as the generated `src/generated/backend/services/CheckInsService.ts` and the models `src/generated/backend/models/CheckInDto.ts` , `src/generated/backend/models/CreateCheckInDto.ts`, `src/generated/backend/models/ListCheckInsResultDto.ts` and `src/generated/backend/models/UpdateCheckInDto.ts`
